Profile with surface, north-south from the west
The cave, named after the speleologist and diver Aleksandr Verëvkin,
was discovered in 1968. The entrance is located 2.230 m a. s. l., in the
In August 2017 it became the deepest cave in the world; in 2020 its
depth was 2212 m and its length 17.5 km (10 km below 2100 m). The
map is based on the profile by Perovskij speleo club (Moscow, pres.
of DZRJL, Ljubljana Cave Exploration Society (Slovenia).
